scope: external D-FINE-L evaluation adapter for VisDrone

repair.root_cause: FP16 autocast overflow in a denoising decoder output during from-scratch VisDrone training; raw COCO boxes were validated finite, positive, and in bounds
repair.change: Set use_amp=False, removed the --use-amp override, and set total_batch_size=4 to avoid a high-target FP32 OOM on the 24GB GPU; official D-FINE model, loss, data pipeline, seed, resolution, and evaluation contract are unchanged

provenance_note: Metadata only; raw data and model weights stay on the server. No D-FINE metric is registered because training failed before a valid checkpoint/evaluation.
